crew.overview: When the Bad Guys, a crew of criminal animals, are finally caught after years of heists and being the world’s most-wanted villains, Mr. Wolf brokers a deal to save them all from prison.
crew.title: The Bad Guys

crew.original_title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
crew.overview: Puss in Boots discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll: He has burned through eight of his nine lives, leaving him with only one life left. Puss sets out on an epic journey to find the mythical Last Wish and restore his nine lives.
crew.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

crew.overview: When Branch's brother, Floyd, is kidnapped for his musical talents by a pair of nefarious pop-star villains, Branch and Poppy embark on a harrowing and emotional journey to reunite the other brothers and rescue Floyd from a fate even worse than pop-culture obscurity.
crew.title: Trolls Band Together

crew.overview: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.
crew.title: The Wild Robot

details.biography: Jeremy Schaefer is a 22 year old graduate of Ringling College. Growing up in Kentucky, he discovered his passion for art and filmmaking while creating films with his older brother. At school, he honed his skills and created projects to land him an internship at Walt Disney Animation Studios. He set out to create his animated thesis film, “The Box Assassin”. With the guidance from his faculty, he completed the film. After graduation, Jeremy accepted a position as an animator at DreamWorks.
details.name: Jeremy Schaefer
